title: DSA’s Adrian Wall and Former CFTC Chair Chris Giancarlo Discuss Future of U.S. Crypto Regulation at Strobe Summit
summary: Washington, D.C., November 6, 2026 — The Digital Sovereignty Alliance (DSA), a nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing clear and ethical public policy, research, and education related to emerging technologies, participated in the Strobe Summit, where DSA Managing Director Adrian Wall moderated a fireside chat with former Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) Chair Christiopher Giancarlo on the evolving regulatory landscape for digital assets and the future of financial markets. Titled “Crypto at a Crossroads: Regulation, Institutional Adoption, and the Future of Financial Markets,” the discussion examined the path forward for U.S. digital asset policy amid legislative uncertainty and growing institutional interest in blockchain-based financial infrastructure. Drawing on his experience leading the CFTC and founding the Digital Dollar Project, Giancarlo emphasized an approach to regulation that combines clear exchange rules under existing CFTC authority with congressional action to address remaining gaps. The conversation also explored the implications of the GENIUS Act, including Giancarlo’s concerns about financial privacy and his view that dollar-backed stablecoins could become a 24/7 global payment rail, raising fundamental questions about how the dollar moves on-chain and who provides that infrastructure. Wall and Giancarlo also examined the regulatory challenges surrounding prediction markets, perpetual futures, and decentralized finance (DeFi). Topics included the CFTC’s role in overseeing event contracts, bringing offshore derivatives activity into regulated U.S. markets, the potential for 24/7 trading, and establishing accountability for decentralized platforms without traditional intermediaries. The discussion highlighted the need for regulatory frameworks that address market integrity, cybersecurity, customer asset protection, and the operational realities of increasingly interconnected financial markets. “Regulatory clarity requires more than new legislation. It requires rules that reflect how digital asset markets actually operate,” said Adrian Wall, moderator of the discussion. “The CFTC has existing authority to address important market structure questions, while Congress has a critical role in resolving regulatory gaps. Getting that balance right will determine whether the U.S. can bring more digital asset activity onshore, accelerate institutional adoption, and protect market participants without compromising innovation or financial privacy.” DSA’s participation reflects its commitment to advancing informed policy dialogue and practical regulatory approaches that support responsible innovation, market integrity, and the integration of digital assets into the broader financial system. About the Digital Sovereignty Alliance The Digital Sovereignty Alliance (DSA) is a nonprofit social welfare organization committed to advocating for public policies that support ethical innovation in decentralized technologies, blockchain, cryptocurrency, Web3, and artificial intelligence. DSA conducts research, organizes educational events, and promotes policies that prioritize public welfare and digital sovereignty. Media contact Maghan Lusk info@discoverdsa.org

title: StockFi: Connecting U.S. Stock with the On-Chain Ecosystem to Reshape Asset Circulation
summary: Start with one stock. Connect two capital worlds. 6 November — Singapore — StockFi is advancing the connection between traditional equities and the on-chain ecosystem through U.S. stock tokenization. Built on BSC, the platform brings stock tokens and the meme ecosystem into its development strategy, exploring new ways to serve on-chain users worldwide through asset issuance, on-chain circulation and product applications. StockFi’s approach connects the underlying value of equities, the utility of on-chain products and the reach of communities. Starting with its first stock offering, the platform plans to progressively develop asset onboarding, token issuance, trading environments and user access, giving equities broader reach and utility once they enter the on-chain market. “Start with one stock. Connect two capital worlds.” This brand statement reflects StockFi’s understanding of asset tokenization: begin with a specific asset, connect markets through products, and support ecosystem development through sustained use. Building New Market Connections for Digital Assets Equities connect business operations with capital markets, reflecting investors’ assessments of industry development, commercial innovation and long-term value. On-chain networks offer a new digital environment in which assets can connect with users and products across regions through wallets, trading protocols and application interfaces. When equities enter the on-chain market as tokens, the change extends beyond how assets are represented. It also affects how they are discovered, how they circulate, and how they connect with other digital assets and applications. StockFi will focus its development on these areas. Within the platform’s roadmap, equities and on-chain products require clearly defined structural connections. Products and users need convenient access points, while assets entering the market require appropriate liquidity and application support. Bringing these elements together is essential to delivering a complete asset tokenization experience. Through ongoing product development, StockFi aims to combine the market familiarity of traditional equities with the open connectivity of the on-chain ecosystem, creating new opportunities for collaboration among asset issuers, ecosystem partners and eligible users. Three Asset Roles Within One Ecosystem Framework StockFi’s product framework encompasses real stocks, stock tokens and MEME tokens. Each serves a distinct role in connecting assets with communities. Real stocks form the underlying asset foundation, connecting company operations with traditional capital markets. Stock tokens provide the corresponding on-chain representation, serving as a product vehicle for trading, asset information and future applications. MEME tokens connect community culture, content distribution and user participation, helping the platform broaden its market reach. This structure allows StockFi to develop both the asset and user sides of the platform. On the asset side, key questions include where products originate, how they are issued and what rights holders receive. On the user side, participants need to understand a product’s purpose, find an access point and build familiarity through actual use. StockFi plans to bring these two sides closer together through an integrated platform experience. The asset characteristics, uses and holder rights of stock tokens and MEME tokens will be explained separately. Their connections will take shape through trading environments, product integration and community participation, providing complementary foundations for platform development. Connecting the Meme Ecosystem to Broaden the Reach of Stock Tokens Communities are an important part of on-chain markets. Content, discussion and creative work built around shared themes help projects reach across regions and languages to establish distinctive brand cultures. StockFi views the meme ecosystem as an important gateway to users and aims to bring community reach into the stock token experience. Under its development plans, StockFi will select eligible projects from a pool of candidate MEME projects, work toward establishing trading pairs with stock tokens, and provide educational content and product introductions around specific assets. This approach can introduce community users to stock tokens while helping stock tokens attract broader attention and potential demand. These connections require ongoing support from both content and products. After discovering an asset theme, users should be able to learn more about its background, structure and purpose. Once they access the product, they should also find clear information and operating instructions. StockFi will therefore develop its community alongside its products. Through accurate asset introductions, accessible educational content and ongoing ecosystem engagement, the platform aims to turn brand awareness into product understanding and establish a foundation for long-term use. Supporting Assets Through Products, Expanding Utility Through Applications StockFi sees asset issuance as the starting point of its platform services, with subsequent circulation and applications remaining central to its ongoing development. For stock tokens, the platform plans to progressively connect asset arrangements, issuance services, on-chain trading and DApp access. These capabilities will be introduced in stages according to product delivery and partnership progress, creating a continuous path from asset information to practical use. At the asset onboarding stage, the platform plans to work with relevant service providers on stock sourcing, custody and issuance structures, while clearly defining product information and holder rights. For on-chain circulation, StockFi plans to develop stock token trading environments and connect wallets and liquidity services, providing product support for assets entering the on-chain market. For the user experience, the platform will integrate asset displays, project materials and feature access through its DApp, helping users learn about assets, review information and access available services within a single product environment. Together, these elements define StockFi’s product direction: make assets identifiable, information understandable and services usable. As its capabilities develop, the platform will further explore how stock tokens can be used across different on-chain applications. Building an Open, Collaborative StockFi Ecosystem Bringing equities into the on-chain market requires expertise from multiple fields. Asset services, technical development, wallet integration, liquidity and user education each play an essential role along the product journey. StockFi will expand ecosystem partnerships around specific product needs, enabling partners to collaborate within clearly defined service scopes and delivery requirements. For asset and issuance service partners, priorities will include asset selection, asset arrangements, custody, issuance and ongoing disclosure, establishing a clear product foundation for stock tokens. For technology, wallet and liquidity partners, the platform will explore asset displays, trading access and application integrations to progressively improve how stock tokens are accessed and used. For media and community partners, StockFi will provide consistent brand introductions, project materials and educational content, helping more users understand stock tokenization and the platform’s direction through ongoing communication. StockFi aims to build an ecosystem in which every partnership serves a specific product need and every asset onboarded receives appropriate application support. As its network of partners and product use cases grows, the platform will progressively expand its ability to connect assets with users. Starting With the First Stock, Building Toward a Scalable Platform StockFi plans to begin with its first stock offering, connecting assets, issuance, circulation and user access, then refining the product journey based on actual operation. The first offering will establish a reusable foundation for future development. Practical questions—how asset information is presented, how stock tokens enter trading environments, and how users understand and use products—will inform the platform’s subsequent expansion. Building on this foundation, StockFi will consider product delivery, market demand and partnership progress as it explores onboarding additional stock tokens and eligible MEME projects, broadening its asset coverage and application range. The platform’s long-term goal is to establish lasting connections among asset supply, product use and community participation: more products give users greater choice, more use cases support asset demand, and broader community reach contributes to ecosystem development. Starting with one stock, StockFi aims to establish a product pathway into the on-chain market, creating a new connection between traditional equities and the global on-chain ecosystem. Start with one stock. Connect two capital worlds. About StockFi StockFi is a U.S. stock tokenization platform built on BSC, connecting stock tokens with the meme ecosystem. The platform is developing stock token issuance, on-chain trading and applications. Through product services, community education and ecosystem partnerships, StockFi explores lasting connections between traditional equities and on-chain users worldwide, working toward a growth ecosystem in which assets, applications and communities develop together. title: Gate Pioneers Proof of Security (PoSEC), Achieving 104.58% Cold Storage Coverage to Solidify Asset Security
summary: Gate has officially introduced Proof of Security (PoSEC), a new asset security verification framework, becoming the first digital asset trading platform in the industry to launch a PoSEC security verification system. Since its founding in 2013, Gate has consistently placed user asset security at the forefront of its priorities. With the introduction of PoSEC, Gate extends security verification beyond reserve adequacy to include asset storage structures and risk coverage capabilities, further solidifying safeguards for user assets and providing a new practical approach to advancing industry security standards. PoSEC Focuses on Asset Storage Security and Quantifies Extreme-Risk Coverage Capabilities Unlike Proof of Reserves (PoR), which primarily verifies the adequacy of asset reserves, PoSEC places additional emphasis on asset storage security. By publicly disclosing the distribution of assets between platform cold storage and hot wallets, PoSEC provides visibility into asset storage structures and their ability to cover potential losses under extreme scenarios. PoSEC introduces the cold storage coverage ratio as a key metric to measure the extent to which cold storage covers total user assets. A coverage ratio ≥ 100% means that, under the applicable calculation methodology, cold storage alone would be sufficient to cover all user assets even if all assets held in hot wallets were lost. PoR and PoSEC serve complementary purposes, extending asset security verification from reserve adequacy to storage security and risk coverage, while providing users with more comprehensive and transparent information about asset security. Cold Storage Coverage Reaches 104.58%, with Open and Transparent Storage Structure According to the snapshot taken at 00:00 (UTC) on November 4, 2026, Gate’s cold storage coverage ratio reached 104.58%, with cold storage and hot wallet assets accounting for 88.26% and 11.74% of total assets, respectively. Cold storage assets include digital assets held offline and traditional assets under independent custody. To qualify, these assets must meet requirements such as not being directly used for routine deposits and withdrawals, being held offline or under independent custody, requiring multi-party authorization for transfers, and being independently verifiable. The current data is undergoing verification by an independent third-party audit firm. The review covers asset authenticity and control, valuation and calculation methodologies, and coverage ratio calculations. The audit report will be published on Gate’s official website upon completion, enhancing the transparency and credibility of asset security disclosures. From PoR to PoSEC: Continuously Strengthening Digital Asset Security Gate has long been committed to digital asset security and transparency. In 2020, Gate was among the first in the industry to introduce an open-source Proof of Reserves (PoR) mechanism and a Merkle Tree-based asset verification solution, establishing itself as an early contributor to reserve transparency in the industry. Gate subsequently incorporated technologies such as zk-SNARKs to enhance its asset reserve verification framework. As of October 18, 2026, Gate’s total reserves amounted to approximately $8.688 billion, with an overall reserve ratio of 118.49%. The platform also employs a range of security mechanisms, including hot and cold wallet segregation, multi-signature technology, Multi-Party Computation (MPC), dynamic risk monitoring, and zero-trust access control, to establish a multi-layered security framework covering asset reserves, storage management, and risk protection. From PoR, which verifies reserve adequacy, to PoSEC, which verifies asset storage security and risk coverage capabilities, Gate is progressively building a multi-layered security framework encompassing asset reserves, storage management, risk protection, and public verification. Looking ahead, Gate will continue to uphold its security-first principle, further develop PoSEC standards and verification mechanisms, and collaborate with more industry participants to enhance asset security and transparency, laying a stronger security foundation for the long-term, sustainable development of the digital asset industry. Learn more: https://www.gate.com/proof-of-security About Gate Gate, founded in 2013 by Dr. Han, is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency and integrated financial services platforms, spanning financial and everyday use cases including asset management, trading and payments. Serving over 62 million users globally, it supports trading across 5,400+ digital assets and 12,800+ stock assets and ETFs, while providing access to a comprehensive range of TradFi assets, including metals, stocks, indices, forex, and commodities to meet users’ end-to-end needs across asset holding, trading, and spending. As an industry benchmark, Gate was among the first platforms to implement 100% Proof of Reserves. Its ecosystem includes Gate Money, Gate Wallet, Gate Ventures, Gate for AI Agent, and a wide range of products and services. title: Bitbase Launches ORIGIN, a Points Season That Rewards Consistency
summary: PANAMA CITY, November 4, 2026 — Bitbase today launched ORIGIN, the first season of its Bitbase Points program, which is designed to reward sustained participation over time. Over the 26-week season, which ends on May 4, 2027, Bitbase will distribute 1,000,000 points each week, allocated daily according to each participant’s contribution. Four sources of contribution Each participant’s contribution is drawn from four sources: trading, assets held on Bitbase, consistent activity and referrals. Consistent activity is counted as a separate source, so continued participation from day to day adds to a user’s contribution. All eligible users, whether new to Bitbase or already active on the platform, are enrolled automatically. For each new user referred directly, the referrer receives an additional 25% of that user’s contribution. The new user’s own points are not affected. Participants will also receive a Trading Identity card, a shareable summary of their trading style. The first cards will be issued on November 9, with new cards following each Monday for the remainder of the season. Existing users begin with points already credited Before the season began, Bitbase credited points to eligible existing users based on their earlier activity on the platform. As a result, these users enter ORIGIN with their prior activity already reflected in their points and ranking. The first program under Bitbase 2.0 On November 2, the exchange introduced Bitbase 2.0, updating its brand, app and website under the statement “Market Flows. We Focus.” ORIGIN is the first program to put that statement into practice. While markets move continuously, Bitbase has chosen to assess participation across months rather than individual moments. “We designed ORIGIN for users who participate consistently, not only during the busiest periods in the market,” said Nicholas Lo, Chief Business Officer at Bitbase. “Over a six-month season, that consistency carries weight. Our responsibility is to make sure every contribution is credited, from the first day of the season to the last.” Points and rankings are available in the Bitbase app and at bitbase.com/points. About Bitbase Bitbase is a digital asset exchange serving individual and institutional users worldwide, with products spanning Spot, Futures, TradFi and Earn. Bitbase aims to give users a stable and straightforward trading experience, in line with its brand statement, “Market Flows. We Focus.” Learn more at bitbase.com. Media contact Harry Yang Content Lead, Bitbase marketing@bitbase.com

title: Bitbase launches ORIGIN, distributing 1M points every week
summary: Panama City, November 4, 2026 — Bitbase today launched ORIGIN, the first season of its new Bitbase Points program. Ahead of the launch, the digital asset exchange credited points to eligible users who had been trading on the platform, so their past activity counts from day one. The season runs for 26 weeks, until May 4, 2027, with 1,000,000 points distributed each week. Part of Bitbase 2.0 ORIGIN is also the first part of Bitbase 2.0 to reach users directly. Bitbase unveiled 2.0 on November 2, with an upgraded app and website and a new brand identity built around the statement “Market Flows. We Focus.” The idea is that markets will always move, and Bitbase chooses to focus on what lasts for its users. ORIGIN applies the same thinking to participation. Rather than rewarding a single burst of activity, it looks at what users do day after day over six months and credits the contribution they make across that period. How participation is counted Bitbase built ORIGIN around what users already do on the exchange. Eligible users, new or existing, are enrolled automatically, with no separate registration. Points are allocated daily based on each participant’s contribution, which draws on four sources: trading, assets held on Bitbase, consistent activity and referrals. Because consistency is one of those sources, steady participation adds up over the course of the season. ORIGIN also rewards users who bring others to Bitbase. A referrer receives an additional 25% of the contribution of each new user they refer directly, while the new user’s own contribution is unaffected. Starting November 9, participants will also receive a shareable Trading Identity card that reflects their trading habits, with a new card issued every Monday until the season ends. Recognition that continues through the season “Bitbase 2.0 is about focus, and for our users, that means knowing their steady participation is recognized and credited,” said Nicholas Lo, Chief Business Officer at Bitbase. “That’s why ORIGIN started by crediting what users had already done with us. It doesn’t ask anyone to trade differently. It simply records the participation that’s already there, every day, for the next six months.” Users can track their points and rankings in the Bitbase app and on the website. Full details are available at bitbase.com/points. About Bitbase Bitbase is a digital asset exchange serving individual and institutional users worldwide, with products spanning Spot, Futures, TradFi and Earn. title: MEXC Expands Stock Futures Coverage to Six Global Markets in Q3 as 0808 Stock Season Trading Volume Tops $50B
summary: Mutsamudu, Comoros, November 4, 2026 – MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, has released the “MEXC Ecosystem & Growth Report Q3 2026.” Building on the launch of RealStocks and the expansion of its stock product offering in Q2, MEXC broadened its market coverage and attracted greater user participation in Q3 The number of RealStocks traders in July-August increased by 608% compared with May–June. By the end of September, the platform offered more than 460 Stock, Index, and ETF Futures contracts across six global markets. During the quarter, MEXC expanded the global reach of its Stock Futures offering, adding Taiwanese stocks in September. In July–August, single-stock Futures trading volume rose 179% compared with May–June, while Index and ETF Futures trading volumes increased by 288% and 483%, respectively. Trading activity also expanded beyond individual U.S. stocks to include Asian equities, such as South Korean stocks, and semiconductor ETFs. Spot trading also recorded growth across stock-related products. In July–August, the number of first-time MEXC RealStocks traders increased by 561% compared with May–June. By the end of August, the number of RealStocks users holding positions had risen 105.2% from the end of June. Over the same period, the share of RealStocks trading volume attributable to index-related products and ETFs increased from 12.6% to 24.3%. For tokenized stocks, 49.20% of trading volume in July–August occurred during U.S. pre-market, after-hours, and overnight sessions. Tokenized stock trading volume rose 81% month over month in September, reflecting demand for trading opportunities outside regular U.S. stock market hours. MEXC’s inaugural 0808 annual trading event, held under the theme “Stock Season,” attracted more than 86,000 participants, generated over $50 billion in trading volume, and delivered more than $1 million in trading fee savings to users. MEXC also partnered with Kaito to offer up to $200,000 in stock market education incentives. Through content creation and referral rewards, the initiative encouraged creators and KOLs to share knowledge about equity markets and related products. MEXC CEO Vugar Usi said, “As more ways to access markets become available, users face increasingly complex decisions. RealStocks, tokenized stocks, and Stock Futures may all reference the same company, yet have different trading mechanisms and risks. For MEXC, expanding our product offering is only the first step. What matters more is helping users clearly understand each product’s features, costs, and risks, and providing trading tools and investor education so they can make choices that suit their needs.” Stock-related themes also gained traction in the on-chain new-token market during Q3. Stock-themed meme tokens 4STOCK and MEMEROBINHOOD ranked second and third, respectively, among MEXC’s top 10 newly listed tokens by Q3 Spot trading volume. Meme tokens occupied six of the top 10 spots, up from three in Q2. The top 10 tokens recorded an average peak gain of 3,246%, up 51% from Q2. Robinhood Chain projects occupied five spots in the peak-gain rankings. These projects spanned stock-themed meme tokens, AI applications, liquidity management, and token issuance services, reflecting the diversity of activity in the on-chain new-token market. MEXC also expanded its AI-powered trading tools and digital asset payment offerings. Launched on September 28, MEXC CLI allows users to connect their own AI agents to MEXC, retrieve market and account information using natural language, and execute trades with user confirmation. During Q3, MEXC’s AI features recorded an average of more than 87,000 daily active users, with cumulative users exceeding 1.25 million. On August 31, MEXC also launched the MEXC Global Card, a USDT-funded virtual Visa card that supports Apple Pay and Google Pay, expanding the use of digital asset for everyday payment. In September, MEXC allocated an additional 1,000 BTC to the Guardian Fund, bringing its total BTC holdings to 2,000 BTC. In July–August, the platform successfully intercepted stolen or fraud-related fund inflows across 215 reported cases, with attempted inflows totaling approximately 38.66 million USDT. Over the same period, MEXC identified and restricted 20,752 risk-related accounts, reflecting its ongoing efforts to strengthen risk detection and prevent illicit fund flows. For more on MEXC’s Q3 performance and ecosystem growth, read the “MEXC Ecosystem & Growth Report Q3 2026.” About MEXC Founded in 2018, MEXC is a leading global multi-asset trading platform built as your 0-fee gateway to infinite opportunities. Serving users across 170+ markets, MEXC provides simple and efficient access to crypto, stocks, tokenized assets, derivatives, and a growing range of TradFi-linked opportunities through one account and one gateway. With 0 trading fees, deep liquidity, broad asset coverage, and a high-performance trading experience, MEXC is designed for retail users who want to discover earlier, act faster, and trade with fewer barriers. As crypto and traditional finance continue to converge, MEXC is committed to making global opportunities more accessible, helping users trade freely and MEXCmize every opportunity.
